Inkwell

Self-hosted F-Droid repo for Inkwell, a native reader and writer for the Standard.site publishing ecosystem on AT Protocol. Source: https://github.com/ewanc26/inkwell-android

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://inkwell.ewancroft.uk/fdroid/repo
